articles.title: Microsoft offers voluntary exit package to 60K employees across India, US, UK and Canada

articles.title: India and United States Face Economic Friction Despite Strategic Partnership
articles.summary: India and the United States announced an interim trade agreement framework in February 2026 to address long-standing economic disputes. Negotiators must carefully balance international commitments against intense domestic political pressures to ensure long-term stability and growth in their bilateral economic partnership.

articles.title: Maharashtra Government Forms Special Investigation Team to Probe Audio Clip
articles.summary: On Monday, the Maharashtra government formed a three-member special investigation team to conduct an in depth inquiry into an audio clip released by Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange. articles.title: Austria FM to visit India, hold talks with Jaishankar
articles.summary: New Delhi: Austria’s Federal Minister for European and International Affairs Beate Meinl-Reisinger will be on an official visit to India from October 27 to November 2, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) announced Monday. articles.summary: The teaser of Prabhas-starrer Fauzi has triggered a fresh controversy over its depiction of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and Adolf Hitler. articles.title: Dutch government plans to cut 25,000 jobs in efficiency drive
